value.text: FAQ International Students (must read!) Preparatory German course : Before the semester begins, you will have the opportunity to participate in an intensive German course. value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: Before the semester starts, a preparatory German Pre-Semester Intensive Course is being offered in September or March. It costs approximately. €295, and students will be awarded 6 ECTS. Most Erasmus students are only eligible to take part if they have proven German proficiency at the A2 level until the application deadline and after passing the evaluation test upon their arrival. Students also have the chance to attend German courses during the semester. Information can be found on the "ZEMS" website . Insurance Information VISA application information FAQs & Timeline Cost of Living Expenses: Housing €350-650 per month/food and drink €150 per month/books and supplies €40 per month/health insurance (if not waived) € 120-130 per month. Students applying for a residence permit have to prove sufficient financial resources of €992 per month – this will give you a rough estimate of what the average student needs. Depending on the individual lifestyle, this can be less or more.

completion_observations.text_zh: FAQ 舊預算約每月 €900，住宿 €350–650、餐食 €150，學期分攤約 €250 含公共運輸；同頁仍引用2023年財力額，費用與簽證財力須另核最新版本。
completion_observations.scope: FAQ 未指定2027–28，且財力段明列 January 2023；保留舊參考，不當最新法定額

value.heading: 住宿資訊
value.text: KIT reserves rooms in student residences for students from partner universities. Accommodation is guaranteed if students adhere to the application procedure and deadlines. Details are sent by email after admission to KIT. The furnished single rooms cost between €250 and €350 per month and are rented for fixed lease periods: October to March (winter semester) and/or April to September (summer semester) . Please note that these rental periods are non-negotiable, and no alternative move-in or move-out dates are available. Please note that accommodation prices on the private market are significantly higher than those in student dorms, and there is also a risk of scams . For this reason, we highly recommend applying for a room in a student dorm through us. For students attending the pre-semester German language course (starting mid-September in the winter semester/mid-March in the summer semester), we recommend reserving accommodation in youth hostels, hostels, or Airbnb for the two weeks before the rental period of guaranteed rooms in the student residences. This must be arranged privately, as KIT unfortunately cannot assist with finding housing on the private market.

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: For a good start to the semester at KIT, all incoming students are allowed to participate in a three-week German language course (beginners and intermediate A2-B2) before the semester begins. This course is not a substitute for the certificate of the German language level required for the application . The course fee is 75 euros for international students. Students will get 4 ECTS if they attend 80% of the course and pass the exam. During the semester, the Studienkolleg at KIT offers free German language courses for all students enrolled at KIT. Health insurance coverage is mandatory for your entire stay in Germany, with unlimited coverage. You can either obtain private health insurance in your home country before arriving in Karlsruhe or take out a German public health insurance before or after arrival. However, we strongly recommend choosing German public health insurance , as many private policies from non-EU countries may not be accepted. Without valid insurance, enrolment at the university is not possible. Students from partner universities pay a charge for the Studierendenwerk of about 92 € per semester. This includes reduced student prices at the university restaurant, transportation reductions, and accident insurance. Cost of Living

value.heading: 實用資訊
value.text: Language courses for exchange students VISA application information Exchange students must have comprehensive health insurance valid in Germany for enrolment as a fulltime student at FU Berlin AND for obtaining a residence permit. Exchange students are exempt from university fees, but they still need to pay the so-called semester ticket and social fees of approx. € 330 per semester.These fees are not paid to the university, but instead go to the student union and cover the cost of a public transportation ticket for the Berlin metropolitan area for the entire semester. Students will be asked to pay the fees before arrival in Berlin as part of the enrollment process. Freie Universität Berlin offers two scholarships for a period of ten months (1 October 2027 – 31 July 2028) with the following terms: - € 800 as a monthly grant; - € 500 health insurance allowance per semester; - Reimbursement of student fees (approx. € 300 per semester); - A waiver of registration fees.

value.heading: 注意事項
value.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有相對應的系所及足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收 。 該校絕大多數學士班課程為德語授課，僅具備英語能力者請務必確認是否有 足夠課程 可供選讀 Website of incoming exchange student information Course catalogue Please note that Human Medicine and Veterinary Medicine are NOT open to exchange students. With few exceptions, all undergraduate programs are open for exchange students. Enrollment in the following courses is subject to availability of lab classes and to prior approval by the institute/department: Biochemistry, Bioinformatics and Biology . Restrictions apply in Pharmacy, Law, Business Administration and Economics . The Law Department prefers direct exchange students from institutions who also accept law students. There are only very few places available for other exchange programs. The following master's degree programs are open for postgraduate exchange students without restriction: modern German literature, philosophy, and political science. All other master's degree programs are restricted and need prior approval from the institute/department.

value.text: Language courses for international and exchange students Cost of living: SEK 10,584-14,950 per month It is very important that all international students have complete insurance coverage for their entire stay in Sweden. Consequently, KTH asks all international students to have a complete insurance cover when arriving to KTH. value.heading: 注意事項
value.text: 交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有 相對應的系所及 足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收。 Website for incoming exchange student information. Useful information about courses for exchange students is listed here : 60 credits should be selected in order to have reserve options. Please note, the Swedish Migration Agency requires students to be accepted to full–time studies to issue residence permits for non-EU/EES students. Full-time study means 30 credits (or higher education points) per term . You cannot receive a residence permit for distance learning or online courses. Restricted subject areas for exchange students: Business Studies – Entry requirements vary considerably and are generally high. Admission to Master level courses requires a finished Bachelor's degree majoring in Business Studies. Limited spaces on certain courses. Biomedicine – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Limited spaces. Economics – Courses are not available to exchange students. Government - Course availability is limited, particularly for courses with general entry requirements. History – Some courses have limited capacity. Immunology – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Very limited spaces on courses. Law – Students must have completed at least two years of prior full-time Law studies. Places on specific courses cannot be guaranteed. Students who meet the academic requirements can normally be offered Law courses but should be flexible regarding course selection, as the courses offered may differ from those initially requested. Medicine – Clinical Medicine courses are not available through university-wide exchange agreements. Students applying for other Medicine courses must have a strong academic background in Medicine. No entry-level courses are taught in English. Musicology – Limited course availability (if any), with high entry requirements. Natural Sciences including Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Engineering – There are few to no entry-level courses taught in English. Students must have a very strong academic background in the relevant subject and meet the specific entry requirements. Very limited spaces on almost all courses. Pharmacy - A very strong academic background is required. Limited spaces. Philosophy – A limited selection of courses is available with high entry requirements. Psychology – Only a small number of basic-level courses are taught in English with extremely limited spaces available. Physiology and Anatomy – Courses are not available to students on university-wide exchange agreements. Sociology – None to very few courses available, with high entry requirements, depending on the semester. Courses offered within regular Bachelor's and Master's programmes, that are not included in the Course Catalogue for Exchange Students, are generally not available to exchange students. Please note: there is NO add-and-drop period at Uppsala University.

completion_observations.text_zh: UCT國際辦可按住房webform協助校內外選項，建議旅行前安排。一般宿舍須隨學術申請提出且不晚於入學前一年7/31；Semester Study Abroad第二學期另給流程，不能當臺大交換已配房或2027固定期限。
completion_observations.scope: 接待校公開一般參考；未明列2027–28，個人交換資格、實際房源或費用仍需核定
